title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Nintendo's paradigm-shifting open-world masterpiece, granting players unprecedented physics-driven freedom across the ruinous kingdom of Hyrule.

title: God of War (2018)
description: Santa Monica Studio reinvents Kratos in Norse mythology, pairing visceral Leviathan Axe combat with a deeply moving father-son pilgrimage.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Rockstar Games' crowning narrative achievement following outlaw Arthur Morgan as the Van der Linde gang disintegrates at the end of the American frontier.

title: Super Mario Odyssey
description: A globetrotting 3D sandbox adventure where Mario teams up with Cappy to possess objects, enemies, and iconic cityscapes.

title: Tomb Raider
description: Crystal Dynamics reboots Lara Croft with a gritty survival origin story on the treacherous lost island of Yamatai.

title: Elden Ring
description: FromSoftware and George R.R. Martin unite for an epic dark fantasy RPG across the Lands Between, winning Game of the Year.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Geralt of Rivia tracks Ciri across the war-ravaged Northern Realms in one of the most celebrated open-world RPGs in gaming history.

title: Persona 5 Royal
description: The Phantom Thieves of Hearts infiltrate cognitive palaces to steal the distorted desires of corrupt adults in Tokyo.

title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
description: Cloud, Tifa, and Aerith venture beyond Midgar into the sprawling planet in Square Enix's sweeping reimaging.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Larian Studios delivers unprecedented player agency, branching narrative depth, and D&D 5e turn-based tactical combat.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
description: High-stakes spy-thriller expansion starring Idris Elba as sleeper agent Solomon Reed in the ruined combat zone of Dogtown.

title: Hollow Knight
description: Team Cherry's haunting insectoid subterranean world of Hallownest, revered for tight nail combat, atmospheric art, and rich lore.

title: Hades
description: Zagreus battles through the Underworld to escape father Hades in Supergiant's breathtaking blend of fast-paced action and episodic dialogue.

title: Celeste
description: A heart-stirring precision platformer about conquering self-doubt, panic attacks, and mountain heights.

title: Stardew Valley
description: ConcernedApe's beloved solo-developed farming sandbox that allows players to leave corporate burnout for tranquil pastoral life.

title: Portal 2
description: Valve's puzzle masterwork featuring Aperture Science's witty AI GLaDOS, Stephen Merchant's Wheatley, and spatial mind-benders.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Three criminals coordinate high-stakes heists across the satire-soaked sunburst landscape of Los Santos.

title: Bloodborne
description: Hunt your nightmares through gothic Yharnam where Victorian blood-healing transforms city dwellers into Lovecraftian terrors.
